display_title: It All Started With a Simple Curiosity
description:
*Just how big is it?*

On a lazy weekend afternoon, Na-Ri was relaxing when her brother Jun-U burst in, all excited, and told her something shocking she hadn’t even been curious about. It was about how impressive her childhood friend Seong-Jun’s was. Na-Ri grimaced, clearly displeased at hearing such information. Then, as Jun-U was heading out, he asked her to bring back a hat Seong-Jun had forgotten. With no other choice, she headed to Seong-Jun's house. Arriving and seeing Seong-Jun asleep, a tiny spark of curiosity ignited in Na-Ri. Unable to resist her curiosity, her footsteps carried her toward the sleeping Seong-Jun...

(Source: Ridibooks, translated) 

*Note: Part of Metatoon's Dongjeongnam Danpyeonseon (동정남 단편선) Collection.*
